summary: A standing instruction that shapes how the model behaves for the whole request: persona, tone, rules, output conventions. It sits in its own field ahead of the conversation rather than inside the user turn.
combines: It is separate from the user turn on purpose. Rules put here are not competing with the user's actual question, and they are not something the user's own text can appear to override.
It is billed as input tokens like any other content, and it is part of the cached prefix, so keeping it byte-stable across a conversation is what keeps caching working.
Lixpi already sends its own system prompt through this path on other providers; on Gemini it is the equivalent of the OpenAI `instructions` field.
note: Already authored and sent by the reasoning pipeline; not a user model-setting parameter.
